name: Renny Fujishima Goldman
original_name: レニー・藤島・ゴールドマン
source:
A genius hacker and a professional who makes her living manipulating information. She is the daughter of a wealthy American family but ran away from home because she hated being tied down by her family. She and Touya have known each other for a long time, but they are now on opposing sides. Touya and Renny end up facing off in “a certain contest,” but…

She has a strong-willed personality, looks down on the protagonist and Kanata, and rarely listens to them, but she’s weak against sexual advances and is always swept off her feet.

She’s extremely proud and can’t stand it when things don’t go her way—a personality that’s the exact opposite of Kanata’s. Touya loves to rub salt in her wounds in all sorts of ways. He’s just like “that boy who can’t help but tease the girl he likes.”

Renny is, of course, a virgin. She has a stunning figure and is highly sensitive.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150903004157/http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/candytoys]official site, archived[/url]]
